function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下可靠來源：

| 來源 | 連結 |
|------|------|
| Bloomberg 金價頁面 | https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/XAUUSD:CUR |
| Reuters 金價行情 | https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/gold |
| Kitco 金價實時更新 | https://www.kitco.com/ |
| 美國商品期貨交易所（CME）金價 | https://www.cmegroup.com/trading/metals/gold.html |

這些網站都會提供即時或延遲數分鐘的黃金價格、歷史走勢圖以及相關新聞。若您需要更精確的數字，請直接前往上述網站或使用金融資訊服務（如 Bloomberg Terminal、Reuters Eikon 等）。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" (What is today's gold price in the US?). We need to provide the current gold price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources like Bloomberg, Reuters, or the London Bullion Market Association. We can also provide typical price ranges. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites.
